final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_fd FROM film GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fd) AS overall FROM r WHERE avg_fd IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT r.avg_rc, r.avg_fd, r.avg_fd - o.overall AS diff FROM r JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE r.avg_fd > o.overall) SELECT AVG(avg_rc), AVG(avg_fd), AVG(diff) FROM k
